summary: Florida Power & Light Co., a subsidiary of NextEra Energy, filed an 8-K reporting the sale of $2.25 billion aggregate principal amount of First Mortgage Bonds in three tranches: $600 million of 5.125% Series due 2036, $600 million of 5.750% Series due 2056, and $1.050 billion of 5.900% Series due 2066. The offering was made under existing shelf registration statements. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation, and includes only legal opinions and a cover page as exhibits.
